design_fields.q1_rationale: The study used all plausible values and handled them appropriately as indicated in the prior extraction.
design_fields.q2_rationale: Manual ERIC full-text review, methods p. 270: SENWT country weight makes countries contribute equally; student-level PISA sampling weights are not reported. Country weight is not evidence of student sampling weighting.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study employed multilevel modeling, which accounts for the clustering of students within schools.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study performed internal validation using a train/test split but did not validate findings on an external dataset.
